title: deckflow-core env payload
description: The `env` member of the envelope returned by `deckflow env check`. Facts about the machine, never verdicts about what a downstream tool will manage to do.

skill.description: The calling skill, declared via --skill-root or DECKFLOW_SKILL_ROOT. Null when none was declared, which is not an error.

update_command.description: Declared by the skill in deckflow-skill.json. Core reports it; core never runs it.

installation.description: managed is updatable by `deckflow update`; vendored is replaced by updating the skill.

executable.description: Which python3 this is. An agent host commonly has three on PATH.

externally_managed.description: True when PEP 668 refuses a plain pip install into this interpreter, as on Homebrew and Debian.

available.description: False when the question could not be asked. Never triggers a download to answer it.

configured.description: Null when not asked. This — not the presence of an environment variable — is the field an authorization decision branches on: a user who logged into DeckHTML has a credential no variable reveals.

host.description: Tools core does NOT broker, reported because the skill needs the fact. There is deliberately no pptx_available here: that also depends on registry reachability and the deck's stage size, which core does not know.
